canonical_project: DataTime Bishkek KR Data Center Data 5
notes: DCD reported launch in June 2024 of a 500 kW, 100-rack Tier III-quality commercial facility in Bishkek, funded by the Russian-Kyrgyz Development Fund and operated by DataTime; earlier DCD reporting announced the same 100-rack/at least 500 kW project. Kursiv's Uptime table lists Datatime Bishkek KR Data Center Data 5 with Tier III design certification.
